items.t: S tronic (DSG) gearbox jerks, slips or goes into limp mode
items.job: Replace DSG mechatronic unit (clutch pack extra if worn)
items.note: A fluid and filter service alone is about $300-450. Replacing the clutch pack as well can add $1,500 or more.

items.t: Cam follower wear damages the high-pressure fuel pump
items.job: Replace cam follower (camshaft and fuel pump extra if damaged)
items.note: If the cam lobe is already worn, the camshaft and high-pressure pump add roughly $1,500-2,500.

items.t: Timing chain tensioner failure
items.job: Replace timing chain, tensioner and guides
items.note: If the chain has already jumped, valve and head repairs can cost $3,000-6,000 more.

items.t: Engine burns oil between changes
items.note: CarComplaints owners report an average of about $3,200. A PCV valve replacement should be ruled out first.

items.t: Water pump and thermostat housing leak coolant
items.job: Replace water pump and thermostat housing assembly
items.note: RepairPal lists about $780-1,340 total for most A3 years.

items.t: PCV valve fails, causing whistling and rough idle
items.note: The later chain-drive engine uses a larger oil separator assembly that costs more.

items.t: Carbon buildup on intake valves
items.note: Usually done with new intake manifold gaskets.

items.t: Ignition coil failure causes misfires
items.note: RepairPal lists about $300-460 for 2007-2010 A3s; many owners replace all four coils.

items.t: Turbo diverter valve fails and boost drops
Diesel high-pressure fuel pump failure
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump, injectors and lines
items.note: If only the pump failed with no debris, the cost is far lower.

items.t: Diesel emissions defeat device fix (recall)
items.note: Done free by Audi under the settlement. Check the VIN.

items.t: Diesel injector line can crack and leak fuel (recall)
items.job: Install improved injector line and dampers

items.t: Driver air bag inflator can rupture (recall)
Fuel tank vent valve can leak fuel (recall)
DSG can suddenly shift into neutral (recall)
ABS and stability control unit can fail (recall)
items.job: Update ABS software or replace ABS unit

items.t: Side curtain air bag may not inflate (recall)
Transmission warning light with limp mode
items.job: Replace DSG mechatronic unit or clutch pack
items.note: CarComplaints owners report an average of about $5,000.

items.t: Engine shuts off while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling and repair fuel or engine fault
items.note: CarComplaints owners report an average of about $7,200, mostly major engine work. Start with diagnosis.

items.t: Passenger air bag can switch off with someone in the seat (recall)
items.job: Replace seat sensor mat and update control module
items.note: Owners have reported waits for parts.

items.t: Fuel tank pump seal can leak fuel (recall)
Passenger air bag inflator can rupture (recall)
Tire pressure warning may come on too late (recall)
Backup camera image goes blank (recall)
items.job: Update infotainment software or replace camera or main unit

items.t: Passenger air bag may be folded wrong (recall)
Front seat belt tensioners may not hold (recall)
Passenger seat sensor connection can come loose (recall)
Coolant leak on the 2.0L engine
items.job: Replace leaking coolant pump or thermostat housing
items.note: Usually covered by the new-car warranty on these years.

items.t: Will not start because the 12V battery drained
items.job: Diagnose battery drain, update software, replace battery if damaged
items.note: RepairPal lists $333-375 for an A3 battery replacement.

items.t: 48V mild hybrid battery fault
items.note: Often covered by warranty; a software update fixes some cars.

items.t: Oil leak near the transmission oil cooler
Gearbox warning with stored fault codes
items.note: Covered by warranty on most of these cars. Hardware repairs cost more.
